newsitem.title: THAILAND: RESEARCH ALERT - TelecomAsia seen buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - TelecomAsia seen buy.

text.p: Seamico Securities said on Friday it rated TelecomAsia Corp Plc a buy due to an increase in its fixed telephone line subscribers in the Thai capital Bangkok.

As TelecomAsia's assets were gradually transferred to the state-run Telephone Organisation of Thailand (TOT), amortization and interest expenses were expected to reach a plateau in the fourth quarter this year or in the first quarter of 1997, Seamico said.
"Margins will improve henceforth as subscribership grows," it added.

TelecomAsia will spend six billion baht ($240 million) on its personal cordless telephone (PCT) network in the first two years. However, much of this amount would be financed by supplier credit, so there would be no capital increase, it said.
The company is scheduled to launch the PCT service in 1997.
It has received a concession from the government to install 2.6 million fixed lines in Bangkok. All lines are expected to be connected by 1999.
TelecomAsia was trading at 46.50 baht, down 0.50, at 0830 GMT.
